# Design Document

## Overview

This spec adds one `harness` MCP tool with three actions (`orient`, `brief`, `phase-log`), moves the two spawn-boundary events onto the plugin hook `sdd-activity.sh`, adds an orchestrator-written `spawn.usage` event that the `--watch` renderer joins per spawn, and edits every SDD skill so the orchestrators only route. It sits beside the existing read-only tools (`spec-lint`, `spec-index`, `spec-status`) and reuses their parsers, root selection and derivation code rather than re-implementing Step 0 in prose. Nothing in the phase, spawn or token totals `--watch` renders changes; the work moves from LLM prose to server and hook code.

## Steering Document Alignment

### Technical Standards (tech.md)
No `steering/tech.md` exists in this repo; the binding standard is `agent-rules.md` — the tool is read-mostly, joins existing roots through `PathUtils.safeJoin` and `selectRoots` (`src/tools/spec-lint.ts:79-83`), and spawns no child process.

### Project Structure (structure.md)
No `steering/structure.md` exists; per `agent-rules.md` server code goes under `src/` with tests in `__tests__/` beside the module, and the hook source of truth is `harness/hooks/` with `plugins/` regenerated by `node scripts/sync-plugin-assets.cjs`.

### Design System (design-system.md) — if applicable
N/A. This spec has no UI surface; the only visual output is the existing `--watch` terminal renderer, unchanged in shape.

## Architecture

The orchestrator calls `harness orient` at Step 0 and `harness brief` before each spawn instead of reading many files and assembling prose; both actions run in the server and reuse `deriveSpecStatus` (`src/core/spec-status-deriver.ts:17-37`), `deriveDocumentApprovalStates` (`src/core/approval-records.ts:98-121`) and `parseTasksFromMarkdown` (`src/core/task-parser.ts:153-356`). The plugin hook gains two seams: on an Agent-tool `PreToolUse` whose `tool_input` names an `sdd-*` subagent and a brief path it appends a `spawn.start` to `harness-events.jsonl`; on `SubagentStop` of a non-orchestrator `sdd-*` agent it appends a `spawn.end`. The orchestrator writes one `spawn.usage` carrying the precise role, result and tokens; `buildModel` (`src/watch/ledger.ts:188-338`) joins it to the hook's spawn pair by agent and time window, valid because one worker runs at a time.

```mermaid
graph TD
    O[orchestrator skill] -->|orient / brief / phase-log| H[harness tool]
    O -->|spawn.usage| L[harness-events.jsonl]
    K[sdd-activity.sh hook] -->|spawn.start / spawn.end| L
    H -->|phase-log block| HF[HANDOFF.md]
    L --> B[buildModel join]
    B --> R[watch render]
```

## Components and Interfaces

### Component 1 — `harness` tool shell
- **Purpose:** One tool, three actions, registered and dispatched like `spec-index`.
- **Interfaces:** `harnessTool: Tool` with `inputSchema` `{ action: 'orient' | 'brief' | 'phase-log', specName: string, phase?: 'requirements'|'design'|'tasks'|'implementation'|'closeout', mode?: 'normal'|'revision'|'repair', template?: string, values?: object, taskId?: string, projectPath?: string }`, `required: ['action','specName']`, `readOnlyHint: false` (brief and phase-log write files). `harnessHandler(args, context)` branches on `action`. Roots come from `selectRoots(args, context)`.
- **Dependencies:** `src/types.ts:58-76` `ToolContext`; `selectRoots` (`src/tools/root-selection.ts:202-221`).
- **Reuses:** registration array `src/tools/index.ts:17-33`; dispatch switch `src/tools/index.ts:35-96`; schema and handler shape `src/tools/spec-index.ts:13-131`.

### Component 2 — `orient` action
- **Purpose:** Return, in one call, the Step 0 state and the next step the skill would choose, for the five routing phases (Requirement 1; NFR Performance).
- **Interfaces:** input `specName`, `phase`, optional `mode`. Output `data` per phase. Document phases (`requirements`/`design`/`tasks`): `{ phase, D, A, verdict, P, narrowCheck, nextStep }`. `D` is the highest `v<n>` in the `<phase>.md` Revision History (0 when the file is absent per 1.4, 1 when the file exists with no Revision History, matching Step 0 `harness/skills/sdd-document-phase/SKILL.md:56-60`); `P` is true when the `v<D>` line contains `Post-cap corrective pass` or `SHOULD_FIX-only corrective pass`; `A` and `verdict` come from the newest `reviews/adversarial-analysis-<phase>*.md` verdict block, `narrowCheck` true when its last lines carry `VERIFIED:` not `VERDICT:` (1.5). `nextStep` applies the decision table `harness/skills/sdd-document-phase/SKILL.md:65-75` first-match-wins, including `mode: revision ⇒ Step R` (1.1). `implementation`: `{ phase, tasks: { total, done, inProgress, open }, nextStep }` from `parseTasksFromMarkdown` (`src/core/task-parser.ts:153-356`), matching Step 0 `harness/skills/sdd-implementation-phase/SKILL.md:61-84` (2). `closeout`: `{ phase, items: { total, done, open }, byClass, nextStep }` from `retrospective-plan.md`, where `byClass` is the open count per target class `{ none, store, harness, code, home }` (`harness/skills/sdd-closeout-phase/SKILL.md:70-85`); the `HARNESS_REPO: none ⇒ harness→to-do` adjustment (`:77-78`) is a launch-time value the server cannot see, so the skill applies it. Matching `harness/skills/sdd-closeout-phase/SKILL.md:54-85` (3). Approval/phase state for the implementation branch is `deriveSpecStatus` + `deriveDocumentApprovalStates` (`src/tools/spec-status.ts:69-79`), not re-derived (1.6).
- **Dependencies:** the spec dir under `PathUtils.getSpecPath` read through `safeJoin`.
- **Reuses:** `src/tools/spec-status.ts:69-79`; `src/core/task-parser.ts:342-355`.

### Component 3 — `brief` action and `taskBlock`
- **Purpose:** Write a worker brief from a named template with every placeholder filled and return its absolute path (Requirement 2).
- **Interfaces:** input `template` (a named server-side template), `values` (a map of placeholder to value), optional `taskId`, and the output path derived under the spec dir / scratch dir the caller names in `values`. Output `{ path }`. Placeholders are `{{key}}`; a required placeholder with no value in `values` returns `success: false` naming the key and writes no file (2.3). When `template` is the implementer brief and `taskId` is set, the brief's task-block placeholder is filled by a new `taskBlock(content, taskId)` in `task-parser.ts` that returns `lines.slice(lineNumber, endLine).join('\n')` for that task, where `lineNumber` and the next checkbox index bound the block (`src/core/task-parser.ts:164-176`); the written block equals that slice byte for byte (2.2). When `agent-rules.md` exists at the spec-store root the first line is `Read and obey <path> first.` (2.4, `harness/skills/sdd-document-phase/references/briefs.md:4-11`).
- **Dependencies:** `PathUtils.safeJoin` for the write path.
- **Reuses:** `parseTasksFromMarkdown` `src/core/task-parser.ts:153-356`.

### Component 4 — `phase-log` action (`handoff-phase-log`)
- **Purpose:** Regenerate the HANDOFF `## Phase log` rows for one spec from `phase.end` events (Requirement 5).
- **Interfaces:** input `specName`. It reads `HANDOFF.md` and the spec's `harness-events.jsonl`, then rewrites only the `## Phase log` block, leaving the routing header (`harness/skills/sdd-continue/references/formats.md:69-78`) and the `## <spec> — <stage>` sections (`:80-81`) untouched. The block is one shared table keyed by `Spec`; rows whose `Spec` cell is another spec are preserved verbatim (`src/watch/ledger.ts:145-157`). For this spec: a `phase.end` with no existing row adds a row (dedup as `src/watch/ledger.ts:209-211`); a pre-ledger hand-written row with no matching `phase.end` is kept (5.3); a `phase.start` with no matching `phase.end` that is not the live phase — `run.end` present or a prior run (`src/watch/ledger.ts:216-224`) — emits a row with Result `interrupted` and the `phase.start` entry-snapshot state (5.4). Row shape `harness/skills/sdd-continue/references/formats.md:56-57`.
- **Dependencies:** `handoffPath` `src/watch/index.ts:35-39`.
- **Reuses:** `parseHandoffPhaseRows` `src/watch/ledger.ts:145-161`; block re-serialize modeled on `IndexGenerator.render`/`generate` `src/core/index-generator.ts:44-72`, `:159-211`.

### Component 5 — hook spawn events (`sdd-activity.sh`)
- **Purpose:** Write `spawn.start`/`spawn.end` to `harness-events.jsonl` from the hooks (Requirement 3).
- **Interfaces:** the existing `PreToolUse`/`SubagentStart`/`SubagentStop` matchers are unchanged (`harness/hooks/hooks.json:4-38`); the script keeps appending its `tool`/`agent.start`/`agent.stop` `ActivityEvent` lines (`ActivityEvent`/`LedgerEvent` shapes `src/watch/ledger.ts:14-32`) to `harness-activity.jsonl` (`harness/hooks/sdd-activity.sh:44-67`, 3.7). It additionally: on `PreToolUse` whose `tool_input.subagent_type` starts with `sdd-` (last segment after `:`) and whose `tool_input.prompt` contains a brief path, appends a `LedgerEvent` `{ ts, type: 'spawn.start', run, spec, agent, role }` to `harness-events.jsonl`, where `spec` is the spec-dir basename and `role` is the coarse label — the brief filename stem before `-brief`; on `SubagentStop` of an `sdd-*` agent whose type does not end in `-orchestrator`, appends `{ ts, type: 'spawn.end', run, spec, agent }`. It writes nothing without a matching pointer line or for a non-`sdd-*` agent (3.4, `:11-26`). Orchestrator spawns stay with the supervisor because their launch prompt carries no brief path (3.6). The brief-path detection fires only for the brief-launched workers — drafter, lint/reviser, document-phase adjudicator (`adjudication-brief-<PHASE>.md`, `harness/skills/sdd-document-phase/SKILL.md:191-195`), implementation-phase implementer, high-risk verifier and adjudicator (`impl-brief-task-<N>.md`/`verify-brief-task-<N>.md`/`adjudication-brief-task-<N>.md`, `harness/skills/sdd-implementation-phase/SKILL.md:85-88`, `:114-118`, `:126-128`), close-out batch implementer — whose prompts name a `*-brief*` file; the prompt-launched workers — reviewer and checker via the adversarial prompt file (`harness/skills/sdd-document-phase/SKILL.md:136`, `:211`), the end-to-end verifier via `verify-e2e.md` (`harness/skills/sdd-implementation-phase/SKILL.md:174-177`), the close-out verifier, fix implementer and adjudicator via `closeout-verify-*`/`closeout-fix-*`/`closeout-adjudication-*` (`harness/skills/sdd-closeout-phase/SKILL.md:136`, `:141`, `:145`) — carry no brief path, so the hook writes no `spawn.start`/`spawn.end` for them; Component 6 synthesizes their node from `spawn.usage`.
- **Dependencies:** the pointer file and `SPEC_DIR`/`SDD_RUN_ID` the script already resolves (`harness/hooks/sdd-activity.sh:11-29`); `node` `fs.appendFileSync`.
- **Reuses:** the agent-name derivation `harness/hooks/sdd-activity.sh:36`; the `tool_input` reader `:45-58`.

### Component 6 — orchestrator `spawn.usage` event and `--watch` join
- **Purpose:** Carry the precise role, result and token count on one orchestrator event and join it per spawn (Requirement 3.5, Requirement 4).
- **Interfaces:** a new event `{ ts, type: 'spawn.usage', run, spec, agent, role, result, tokens, phase, task?, round? }` written to `harness-events.jsonl` by the event script (`harness/skills/sdd-continue/references/formats.md:169-181`). In `buildModel` the spawn-pairing loop is unchanged (`src/watch/ledger.ts:226-248`); a new pass folds each `spawn.usage`, in `ts` order, onto the nearest earlier `SpawnNode` of the same `agent` that no earlier `spawn.usage` has already claimed — a once-only, unconsumed match, the same `!s.endedAt` one-time pairing the spawn loop uses (`src/watch/ledger.ts:241`) — coercing `Number(tokens)` (the event script writes every value as a string, `harness/skills/sdd-continue/references/formats.md:178`) and setting `role` (the precise value), `result`, `tokens`, `phase`, `task`, `round` on that claimed node. When no unconsumed same-agent node exists — a prompt-launched worker, a reused-agent prompt-launched worker whose agent's earlier brief node is already claimed (the end-to-end verifier after the per-task verifier, the close-out fix implementer after the batch implementer), or a dropped `spawn.start` hook — the pass synthesizes a `level: 2` `SpawnNode` with `startedAt = endedAt =` the usage `ts` and the usage's `role`/`result`/`tokens`/`phase`/`task`/`round`, so `src/watch/render.ts:121`, `:180-208` renders it and `tokensTotal` (`src/watch/ledger.ts:273`) sums it; because each `spawn.usage` claims exactly one node, a correct node's `role` is never relabelled and the Overview invariant holds on the new path. An old ledger carries `role`/`result`/`tokens` on `spawn.start`/`spawn.end` and no `spawn.usage`, so its model is unchanged (4.1). The ticker gains a `spawn.usage` branch mirroring `spawn.start`/`spawn.end` at `src/watch/ledger.ts:300-301` so the ticker line keeps the precise role, result and tokens (4.2); `src/watch/render.ts` reads the same `SpawnNode` fields it reads today (`src/watch/render.ts:180-208`) and is otherwise unchanged.
- **Dependencies:** `parseJsonl` torn-tail skip `src/watch/ledger.ts:129-142`.
- **Reuses:** `SpawnNode` `src/watch/ledger.ts:63-78`; `tokensTotal` sum `:273`.

### Component 7 — skill and budget edits
- **Purpose:** Make the orchestrators route only, and state the reduced-context budgets (Requirement 3.3, Requirement 5.2, Requirement 6).
- **Interfaces:** the document, implementation and close-out skills replace their manual Step 0 with a `harness orient` call and their manual brief writes with `harness brief`, drop `spawn.start`/`spawn.end` for workers, and keep `round`, `task.pick`, `task.done`, `note`, `phase.*` and one `spawn.usage` per spawn (`harness/skills/sdd-continue/references/formats.md:185-197`). `sdd-continue` stops hand-writing phase-log rows and calls `harness phase-log`, keeping the supervisor's orchestrator `spawn.start`/`spawn.end` (`harness/skills/sdd-continue/SKILL.md:139-143`, `:180-199`). `formats.md` adds the `spawn.usage` row and marks worker `spawn.start`/`spawn.end` hook-written. The implementation `BUDGET` stays 20 tasks and close-out stays `all items` (`harness/skills/sdd-continue/SKILL.md:173`), each with a sentence that the budget assumes the reduced context (6.1, 6.2).
- **Dependencies:** `node scripts/sync-plugin-assets.cjs` regenerates `plugins/`.
- **Reuses:** the existing event-script contract `harness/skills/sdd-continue/references/formats.md:169-181`.

## Data Models

### spawn events on `harness-events.jsonl` (`LedgerEvent`, `src/watch/ledger.ts:14-20`)
```
spawn.start  (hook):        { ts, type, run, spec, agent, role }          # role = coarse, from brief filename
spawn.end    (hook):        { ts, type, run, spec, agent }
spawn.usage  (orchestrator):{ ts, type, run, spec, agent, role, result, tokens, phase, task | round }
```

### orient result (per phase)
```
document:       { phase, D, A, verdict, P, narrowCheck, nextStep }
implementation: { phase, tasks: { total, done, inProgress, open }, nextStep }
closeout:       { phase, items: { total, done, open }, byClass, nextStep }
```

## Error Handling

1. **orient, document absent:** return `D: 0`, `nextStep` drafting v1 (1.4); the agent sees "draft v1".
2. **orient/brief/phase-log, spec dir missing or unreadable:** `success: false` naming the path, as `src/tools/spec-lint.ts:85-90`.
3. **brief, missing required value or unknown template:** `success: false` naming the value or template, no file written (2.3).
4. **hook, no pointer line / non-`sdd-*` / no brief path:** the script exits writing nothing to either file (3.4).
5. **missing event script or hook:** the phase still completes; a missing ledger never stops a run (NFR Reliability, `harness/skills/sdd-document-phase/SKILL.md:50-51`), and `parseJsonl` skips a torn final line (`src/watch/ledger.ts:129-142`).
6. **dropped or timed-out spawn hook:** a missed `spawn.start`/`spawn.end` (the hooks carry a 5-second timeout, `harness/hooks/hooks.json:11`, `:22`, `:33`) does not remove the worker or under-count its tokens — the orchestrator's `spawn.usage` synthesizes the node (Component 6). This holds through the plugin-reinstall window `CLAUDE.md` forces after a `harness/` change, when the hook seam is not yet live.

## Testing Strategy

- **Unit:** `src/tools/__tests__/harness.test.ts` asserts `orient` returns the skill-chosen `nextStep` for the six fixture states (1.7); `taskBlock` returns task 3's slice byte for byte and `brief` writes it (2.2); `handoff-phase-log` preserves another spec's rows and emits an `interrupted` row (5.1, 5.4). Extend `src/watch/__tests__/ledger.test.ts` for the `spawn.usage` join and for an old ledger rendering unchanged (4.1); extend `render.test.ts` for the ticker branch (4.2). Run `npx tsc --noEmit` then `npx vitest run` on the touched files.
- **Integration:** a node test drives `sdd-activity.sh` with a fake Agent-tool `PreToolUse` payload and a pointer file, asserting one `spawn.start` line in `harness-events.jsonl`, and a `SubagentStop` payload asserting one `spawn.end`; it asserts only on `fs.appendFileSync` output the node 20 docs guarantee (`agent-rules.md`).
- **End-to-end:** the five scenarios of decomposition entry 6 (`.spec-workflow/spec-decomposition/decomposition.md:152-161`), run at the completion gate: orient at five states, brief for task 3, hooks writing `spawn.start`/`spawn.end`, `--watch --once` on copied `tags-and-setups` and `calendar-and-breakdowns` ledgers, and `phase-log` on the `calendar-and-breakdowns` ledger. The half needing the reinstalled plugin (scenario 3) may defer under the `verification` tag per the release note in `CLAUDE.md`.

## Decisions taken in this document

- D1 — `harness` is one tool with actions `orient`, `brief`, `phase-log`: options were three tools or one multi-action tool; chosen to match requirements D3 and the `spec-index`/`review-task` precedent, keeping the entry's "two tools" as orient/brief and phase-log on the same surface.
- D2 — Brief templates are named server-side templates filled by `{{key}}` placeholders: options were the caller passing a template body or the server holding named templates; chosen because a named template plus server-computed task block (via the parser) is what takes the assembly off the LLM, matching Requirement 2.1's "template name". Keeping the server set in sync with the skills' `references/briefs.md` is a follow-up, not v1 (see Scope notes).
- D3 — The hook derives the coarse `spawn.start` role from the brief filename stem before `-brief`, and skips `SubagentStop` `spawn.end` for `-orchestrator` agents: options were parsing the prompt for a role or using the subagent type; chosen because the filename names the coarse role for a brief-launched worker and the supervisor owns orchestrator spawns (3.6); a prompt-launched worker gets its role from its synthesized `spawn.usage` node (Component 6), and an unmatched `spawn.end` is dropped by `buildModel` anyway (`src/watch/ledger.ts:241-242`).
- D4 — `spawn.usage` is the usage-event name and folds onto the nearest earlier unconsumed spawn of that agent, synthesizing when none is unconsumed: options were widening `spawn.end` or a distinct event; chosen because the hook `spawn.end` carries no usage and one worker runs at a time (`harness/skills/sdd-closeout-phase/SKILL.md:24`), so binding each usage to one unclaimed node keeps a reused-agent prompt-launched worker off its agent's stale brief node.
- D5 — `taskBlock` is a new export on `task-parser.ts` returning the checkbox-to-next-checkbox slice: options were a new module or reusing the parser's indices; chosen to reuse `checkboxIndices` (`src/core/task-parser.ts:164-176`) so the block matches the parser's own bounds byte for byte.

## Scope notes

- Retrospective `orient` is out of v1, carried from requirements D4: the retrospective Step 0 is a preconditions check, not one of the five verification states.
- Porting the skills' `references/briefs.md` into the server template set and keeping the two in sync (a `check:plugin-assets`-style guard) is deferred; v1 ships the named templates the five brief kinds need and records the sync as a follow-up (D2).
- The implementer task block now runs to the next checkbox and so includes an intervening `##` heading, the intended change carried from requirements Scope notes.
- Everything else the decomposition entry lists — the two tools, the two hook changes, the `--watch` merge, the phase-log rendering, the budget wording — is designed above.

## Revision History
- **v3** (2026-09-15) — Round-2 adversarial response (adversarial-analysis-design-r2.md, verdict iterate 1/0/1).
  - **R2-1 — Accepted (MUST_FIX).** Component 6's fold now binds each `spawn.usage`, in `ts` order, to the nearest earlier same-agent node no earlier `spawn.usage` has claimed (an unconsumed match, grounded in the pairing loop's `!s.endedAt` one-time pairing `src/watch/ledger.ts:241`), and synthesizes when none is unconsumed, so a reused-agent prompt-launched worker (end-to-end verifier after per-task verifier; close-out fix implementer after batch implementer) gets its own node and tokens; because each usage claims exactly one node, the `role` overwrite can no longer relabel a correct node. Also applied to D4 (same "nearest open-or-latest" construct replaced by the unconsumed match).
  - **M-R2-1 — Accepted (MINOR).** Component 5's brief-launched list now names the omitted implementation-phase implementer, high-risk verifier and adjudicator, and the document-phase adjudicator (`harness/skills/sdd-implementation-phase/SKILL.md:85-88`, `:114-118`, `:126-128`; `harness/skills/sdd-document-phase/SKILL.md:191-195`), so the `sdd-verifier`/`sdd-implementer` reuse behind R2-1 is visible.
  - **Lint pass.** 3 fixed (L-50/L-51/L-52 bare render.ts:121 on the v2 Lint bullet given the resolvable path src/watch/render.ts:121, both ends read); rejected: L-1..L-32 the v1/v2 set — plain words, coined event/schema/field names, Node stdlib, table/enum literals, or artifacts cited elsewhere; L-33..L-49 Revision-History prose, quoted rejected-token names not citations.
- **v2** (2026-09-15) — Round-1 adversarial response (adversarial-analysis-design.md, verdict iterate 1/2/2).
  - **R1-1 — Accepted (MUST_FIX).** Component 6 now synthesizes a `level: 2` `SpawnNode` (`startedAt = endedAt =` usage `ts`, role/result/tokens/phase/task/round from `spawn.usage`) for any worker with no matching `spawn.start`, so the prompt-launched reviewer, checker, e2e verifier, close-out verifier, fix implementer and adjudicator still render (`src/watch/render.ts:121`, `:180-208`) and count (`src/watch/ledger.ts:273`); the Overview invariant holds. Component 5 splits brief-launched from prompt-launched launches and cites each; D3's role rationale scoped to brief-launched workers.
  - **R1-2 — Accepted (SHOULD_FIX).** Added Error Handling #6: a dropped/timed-out spawn hook (5s, `harness/hooks/hooks.json:11`, `:22`, `:33`) no longer removes a worker or under-counts tokens because `spawn.usage` synthesizes the node; noted the plugin-reinstall window.
  - **R1-3 — Accepted (SHOULD_FIX).** Component 2's `D` rule adds the "document exists, no Revision History ⇒ `D = 1`" branch (`harness/skills/sdd-document-phase/SKILL.md:56-60`).
  - **M1 — Accepted (MINOR).** Tightened `src/watch/ledger.ts:188-248` to `:226-248` (pairing loop) in Component 6 and `:241-242` (unmatched-`spawn.end` drop) in D3.
  - **M2 — Partially accepted (MINOR).** Pinned `byClass`'s `{ none, store, harness, code, home }` shape and the launch-time `HARNESS_REPO` adjustment the skill applies (Component 2); added the fold's `Number(tokens)` coercion (Component 6). Left the fold's exact insertion point to tasks.
  - **Lint pass.** 7 fixed (L-22/L-23/L-33/L-34 bare `src/watch/render.ts:121`/`:180-208` given `src/watch/render.ts`; L-24/L-35 the trailing `:273` re-pointed to `src/watch/ledger.ts:273` where `tokensTotal` lives, which also fixes L-21); rejected: L-1/L-2/L-4/L-28 hook events (`PreToolUse`/`tool_input`/`SubagentStop`) cited in Component 5; L-3/L-13/L-16/L-25 `jsonl` file-extension fragment of `harness-events.jsonl`; L-5/L-6/L-7/L-8 orient schema/output fields (`mode`/`narrowCheck`/`nextStep`/`byClass`) defined here; L-9/L-10/L-11/L-12 brief/tool input fields (`template`/`values`/`taskId`/`specName`) defined here; L-14 `Spec` table column; L-15 `interrupted` Result cell literal; L-17 `prompt` Agent-payload field; L-18 `role` `LedgerEvent` field defined here; L-19 `appendFileSync` Node stdlib; L-20/L-30 `buildModel` cited at `src/watch/ledger.ts:188-338`; L-26 `start` and L-27/L-29/L-31/L-36 `usage` fragments of coined events `spawn.start`/`spawn.usage`; L-32 `taskBlock` new export with `checkboxIndices` cited.
- **v1** (2026-09-15) — Initial draft.
  - **Lint pass.** 11 fixed; rejected: L-1/L-2/L-4 hook matcher/`tool_input` cited in Component 5; L-3/L-20/L-24/L-31 `jsonl` file-extension fragment of a filename; L-6/L-7/L-8 orient/tool schema fields defined here; L-9/L-10 phase-name enum literals; L-11/L-12 orient output fields defined here; L-16/L-17/L-18 `brief` input fields defined here; L-19 `phase-log` input field; L-21 `Spec` table column name; L-22 `interrupted` Result cell literal; L-25 `prompt` Agent-payload field the seam adds; L-27 `role` `LedgerEvent` field defined here; L-28 `appendFileSync` Node stdlib API; L-34 SubagentStop cited in Component 5; L-36 fragment of the coined event `spawn.usage`; L-37 `taskBlock` new export, reused `checkboxIndices` cited.
